topic: Annual financial physical vs ignoring your money (Silas vs Rosa)

scenes.narration: A yearly money checkup catches problems early and adds wealth. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar holding a clipboard labeled ANNUAL FINANCIAL PHYSICAL, comic burst banner reads CATCH IT EARLY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Silas and Rosa both have a job, a 401k, and a card.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man silas and woman rosa at matching kitchen tables, each with paychecks, 401k statements, and credit cards laid out, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Neither has reviewed any account in over seven full years.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, both silas and rosa standing by a calendar showing seven years passing, dusty unopened statements behind them, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Silas trusts the system and never checks fees or interest rates.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, silas on a couch ignoring a stack of statements, comic banner reads NEVER CHECK, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Everything seems to work, so he leaves it all alone.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, silas relaxing on a couch while a small drip slowly leaks money from his retirement account icon, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Rosa books one Saturday morning every June for a money review.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, rosa at a kitchen table with a calendar marked JUNE MONEY DAY, fresh coffee and a checklist beside her, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She checks fees, beneficiaries, allocations, and interest rates on every account.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, close up of rosa's checklist reading FEES BENEFICIARIES ALLOCATIONS RATES with green check marks, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Silas's checkup reveals one point three percent in 401k fees.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked silas at a kitchen table looking at a fee disclosure stamped ONE POINT THREE PERCENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His savings earned almost nothing and lost twenty thousand in growth.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, silas holding a savings statement reading ZERO POINT ZERO ONE PERCENT, comic banner reads TWENTY THOUSAND LOST, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Rosa rebalanced her 401k and switched to high yield savings.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, rosa at a laptop tapping HIGH YIELD SAVINGS, a clean rebalanced pie chart beside her, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She gained an extra fifteen thousand over the same five years.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split scene, left side silas with old papers, right side rosa with a brokerage app reading FIFTEEN THOUSAND MORE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: One Saturday yearly fixes a decade of drift. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar holding a clipboard labeled YEARLY MONEY DAY, comic burst banner reads SEE YOU NEXT VISIT, kids comic book illustration
